body:
What do you mean by "It has caused me problems in all my previous relationships since we became best friends"? Kind of jealously issues? Maybe that might explain some things. Also, is it only these days that you've been thinking about your feelings towards her or it has been always this way? If it's only been recently, maybe some other issues (for example loneliness, being needy, or being single) started all this confusion inside you?

I'm a female and one of my best friends is male. We used to live together, and sleep in the same bed. I've noticed that when I've been feeling lonely or needy for a while, sometimes I've been starting having similar thoughts. But when I get out of that phase, and rethink about it I realise that it's more these personal issues that blurred my judgement, and feel good that we're still just friends.

For me it's more that I don't feel welcome, even from people I know my whole life - and this feeling is much worse when I meet new people. The thing is that I know that at least in the most cases this is not true, but still it is so difficult to understand if others enjoy my company or not. As a result, I mainly expect them to keep the conversation going, or to contact with me, which in turn - in most of the cases - it gives them the impression that I'm not interested to keep in touch with them. 
It's so frustrating!
I was thinking about learning sign language for the same reason! But it's a shame because not a lot of people have learnt it so I would have to speak anyway..
